provenance.command: claude --help (full output kept locally; the option blocks this driver uses are in protocol/1/help-excerpt.txt)
flag_lines: --disallowedTools, --disallowed-tools <tools...>  Comma or space-separated list of tool names to deny
provenance.tool_names: R-14.291 list. Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Bash, Task, WebFetch and WebSearch appear in the 2.1.273 init tools[] (claude_headless_init.json); MultiEdit and Agent do not, and stay as inert deny entries per the ruling.
provenance.default_mode: --permission-mode has no 'default' choice on 2.1.273, so none and readonly keep the default mode by omitting the flag.
